subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own mirroring Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible-history store, and if so through which supported boundary?
rationale: The user-visible bug is plausible, but the straightforward implementation writes to a third-party database and likely adds configuration or operator assumptions that ClawSweeper should not choose automatically.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded sync design
options.body: Define an opt-in Open WebUI integration path with version/schema checks, safe configuration, live proof, and a separate decision on historical backfill.

options.title: Keep this outside core
options.body: Document that Open WebUI's visible chat history is owned by Open WebUI and that Control UI turns are only guaranteed in OpenClaw transcript/context.

options.title: Move to plugin/API work first
options.body: Require a plugin or supported API seam before any Open WebUI-specific persistence bridge lands in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded sync design
recommendation.body: Define an opt-in Open WebUI integration path with version/schema checks, safe configuration, live proof, and a separate decision on historical backfill.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway chat and Control UI history makes steipete the best available routing owner for the product-boundary decision.
